baselineRegressionProof.assertion: unchanged default profile lookup does not reparse
queries with no fallback location phrase do not walk
invalid queries do not enumerate a cold 52870-lot catalogue
baselineRegressionProof.baselineContext: Captured prepare implementation before its early-error guard, replayed with the current canonical parser that supplies clarification errors.

preservedSemantics: Summary keeps source/owner/storage checks, exact demo counters, owner-scoped baseline, invalid/missing/schema/storage-denial behavior, and time-boundary invalidation.
The optional getProfileId adapter keeps its existing behavior.
Only unchanged raw workspace bytes reuse a parsed owner. Invalid IDs never become an owner.
Voice shared location parsing runs first, including standard cities.
All inventory-fallback location phrases and current custom-city resolution remain; no city index/cache was added.
No price, deadline, filter, sorting, purchase or bid rule changed.
An invalid canonical intent returns the existing empty-preparation result before identifier result allocation, inventory filtering or task scheduling.
Valid preparation still yields in bounded chunks, updates progress and matches content; cancellation still stops the remaining work.
limits: Operation counters describe the given fixtures, not milliseconds saved on a phone.
The voice baseline replaces only the two targeted modules with their exact saved v61 source; it is not a full application latency benchmark.
Custom-city location requests may still scan the inventory when the shared location parser has no answer; this preserves their actual matching behavior.
Large stored workspace bytes still need to be read to detect cross-tab/profile changes; this removes repeated JSON parsing, not storage access.
Browser rendering, mobile geometry, Safari, microphone and network latency were not exercised.
Zero row reads/tasks applies only to FasKeywordSearch.prepare on the rejected-query fixtures, not all work performed by a whole page or typed-input UI.

The third baseline replays the captured pre-guard prepare implementation with current clarification-producing parser semantics; it is not a claim that the published v61 parser already emitted every new error.
relatedVoiceValidation: The same voice source also contains the coordinator-requested canonical error preflight before quantity/money extraction, to preserve original currency/negation errors. Its typed and voice behavior is covered by search-night-regressions.cjs; exact-model compile has priority over the fallback parser.
